Will J.D. Vance save the Great Lakes from Trump?
#Trump

Remember when Vance vowed to his fellow Ohioins that he would investigate Norfolk Southerns actions when they blew up millions of gallons of chemicals that left East Palestine and seven surrounding states, including the Great lakes with toxic chemicals? He became VP to avoid that promise
Did anyone really think Vance would save the Great Lakes from the ravages of DoGE?

Not that I believe Vance was ever genuine in his desire to protect the Great Lakes, but conservation minded individuals cannot remain supporting the Republican Party. They will destroy what you love, sacrificed to business interests.
